data.title: 2 ex-DLA chiefs in crosshairs
data.description: <p>The National Anti-Corruption Commission (NACC) has confirmed that two former director-generals of the Department of Local Administration (DLA) are implicated in alleged cheating in the 2025 local government recruitment examination.</p>

data.title: Drug-laced vape liquid raises health fears
data.description: <p>The Department of Medical Sciences has warned e-cigarette users of potentially fatal risks after detecting methamphetamine and etomidate in vape liquid for the first time.</p>

data.title: Cash mules held after drug probe
data.description: <p>Three people have been arrested after a Bangkok police investigation into online drug activity uncovered a scam network allegedly using cash mules to move money and fund drug purchases.</p>

data.title: Tax incentives to boost U-Tapao project in EEC
data.description: <p>The government will introduce tax incentives and other measures to help speed up the long-delayed U-Tapao Airport and Eastern Aerotropolis development project, with the private sector expected to invest about 1.3 trillion baht over the project's life.</p>

data.title: PM orders probe into copter shooting claim
data.description: <p>Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has ordered an investigation into allegations that security personnel fired on civilians from a helicopter during recent unrest in the southernmost provinces, despite a firm denial from the Fourth Army Region commander.</p>

data.title: FDA approvals boost kingdom's vaccine self-reliance
data.description: <p>Thailand has taken steps to strengthen its vaccine supply, with a nine-strain HPV vaccine and a botulinum antitoxin registered by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).</p>

data.title: Domestic violence in crosshairs
data.description: <p>The cabinet approved a bill yesterday to strengthen protections against domestic violence, according to Social Development and Human Security Minister Nikorn Soemklang.</p>

data.title: Rajavithi opens sexual health clinic
data.description: <p>Rajavithi Hospital has opened a sexual health clinic offering consultations and treatment for sexual health problems, gender-affirming care and HPV-related services.</p>

data.title: Young guns take charge
data.description: <p>The appointment of relatively young civil servants, with many years left in public service, to top bureaucratic posts under Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has drawn attention in political and administrative circles.</p>

data.title: Flood relief budget set at B559m
data.description: <p>The cabinet has approved a central budget of 558.7 million baht to provide relief to those affected by flooding during this year's rainy season.</p>

data.title: People's Party queries B400bn loan plan
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has questioned energy transition plans under a 400-billion-baht government borrowing programme, warning that 200 billion baht of projects could miss their objectives and invite corruption.</p>

data.title: Pheu Thai candidate wins Kalasin PAO election
data.description: KALASIN - Pheu Thai candidate Chalermkwan Lottrakul has been elected president of the Kalasin Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) by a landslide, receiving 306,674 votes, according to unofficial results.

data.title: Pheu Thai candidate wins Kalasin PAO president election
data.description: KALASIN - Pheu Thai candidate Chalermkwan Lottrakul has been elected president of the Kalasin Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) by a landslide, receiving 306,674 votes, according to unofficial results.

data.title: USS Abraham Lincoln to dock in Thailand next week
data.description: ⁠The ​aircraft carrier USS ​Abraham Lincoln is expected to dock in Thailand next week, following a prolonged deployment in the Middle East that raised concerns about conditions aboard the US Navy ship.

data.title: THAI says typhoon could disrupt Taipei, Shanghai flights
data.description: Thai Airways International has advised passengers on flights to Taipei and Shanghai on Thursday and Friday to check schedules as they could be disrupted by an approaching storm.

data.title: Palestine flag in Phuket shop angers Israelis
data.description: PHUKET - An argument between a mobile phone shop owner and two Israeli tourists over a “Free Palestine” flag has drawn attention after video of the exchange was posted on social media.

data.title: Visas revoked for threats to Samui zoo owner
data.description: The visas of foreigners who threatened the life of a private-zoo owner on Koh Samui have been revoked, Tourism and Sports Minister Surasak Phancharoenworakul said on Tuesday.

data.title: Acquittal overturned, Prinn gets 3 years for indecent assault
data.description: The Court of Appeal has overturned the acquittal of former Democrat Party deputy leader Prinn Panitchpakdi and sentenced him to three years in prison for indecent assault and taking a minor away from parental care for indecent purposes.

data.title: Second death sentence for serial killer ‘Aem Cyanide’
data.description: n seventh of 15 cases to be decided, court finds cyanide poisoning of creditor was deliberately planned

data.title: 100kg boar takes a stroll along the highway
data.description: A 100-kilogramme "wild boar" let out of its pen for a walk instead wandered off onto a nearby elevated highway, startling motorists and disrupting traffic on Monday. His owner took more than an hour to sweet-talk him into returning home.

data.title: S. Korea seeks Interpol help to track illegal gambling suspects in Thailand
data.description: South Korean police are hunting five suspects believed to have fled to Thailand for allegedly operating an illegal gambling site involving 60 billion won (1.5 billion baht).

data.title: Cabinet to extend social security cover to farm, street, domestic workers
data.description: The Labour Ministry will propose an expansion of social security coverage under Section 33 to include agricultural workers, street vendors and domestic workers.

data.title: Southern border rail track reopens after bombing
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Train services have resumed on the main southern line in Rangae district, following repairs, after it was damaged by a bomb on Saturday night, the State Railway of Thailand said on Tuesday.

data.title: High-tides alert for six central provinces, Bangkok
data.description: Low-lying areas in six central provinces and Bangkok have been warned to prepare for possible flooding caused by very high tides from Tuesday to Saturday this week.

data.title: Illegal hookah shop shut down in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - Authorities have seized 32 illegal hookah sets, known as “Baragu” in Thai, from a shop in Muang district that caters to tourists.

data.title: Convenience store bombed in deep South as two suspects arrested
data.description: PATTANI — Another convenience store was bombed and set ablaze in the deep South, while two suspects were arrested after a brief gunfight in this southern border province on Monday night.
